shared_schema.envelope: schema_version=1.0 and synthetic=true required at input and output
shared_schema.input: customer, ledger {format: json|csv, data: array|string}, payment; optional loan_application and completed_steps
shared_schema.customer: customer_id, name, experience beginner|intermediate|expert, preference guided|concise, kyc_status pending|verified|rejected, aml_flags string array, fake account_iban; optional synthetic card_number
shared_schema.transaction: transaction_id, date YYYY-MM-DD, signed cents-precision amount, currency EUR|USD|GBP, description
shared_schema.payment: ISO 20022-style subset: MsgId, EndToEndId, InstdAmt {Ccy,Value}, DbtrAcct {IBAN}, CdtrAcct {IBAN}
shared_schema.loan: application_id, positive amount, currency, term_months 1..600, purpose
shared_schema.output: status ready|in_progress|review_required; normalized customer, transactions, payment, loan_application, onboarding steps, explained scores, disclaimer
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate function; strict input fields, bounded monetary values, duplicate checks, account consistency, screening gates and final masking checks
shared_schema.error: CLI prints one JSON object with status=error and exits 2 without echoing input

cross_stage_handoffs: Single onboarding functionality: shared input validation -> normalization -> preference-aware prerequisite planning -> masking -> shared output validation
behavior: Beginner or guided preference selects detailed guidance; expert/intermediate concise preference selects short guidance.
Caller-declared completed_steps are checked against profile -> screening -> ledger -> payment -> optional loan prerequisites.
Unverified KYC or any AML flag requires human review and blocks screening and dependent completion.
Onboarding readiness is floor(completed/required*100), always accompanied by its formula and non-creditworthiness explanation.
PAN-like sequences are recursively masked to last four digits in output, including free-text descriptions and injected guidance.
Optional Python explanation_hook receives a copied step and may return bounded nonempty guidance only; never invoked by CLI.
All fixtures are fabricated. Accounts use invalid-country ZZ00 markers. Tests create deterministic randomized histories with seed 145.
Money is normalized to decimal strings, not binary floating-point totals; different currencies are not aggregated.

included: Demonstrative KYC/AML gates and card masking

test_outcomes.cli: Example emitted one JSON object with status=in_progress and exited 0
test_outcomes.error_cli: Missing arguments, nonexistent file and malformed JSON emitted status=error and exited 2
